description: Sets which phase the room of a webinar shows right now: countdown, live, replay or closed. Take it when the room should switch without publishing anything. A host says: "Open the room, we are starting now." It needs the session, the webinar and the phase. A clear yes from the host is needed before it runs, because a room that jumps to live is visible to everyone. It writes on your site, every participant sees the new phase at once, and the campaign is neither published nor taken offline. A replay without a recording is refused with a plain reason. The answer tells you the phase that really stands, which can differ from the one you asked for. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: open the room, go live, start the replay, close the room

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said yes to this phase.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

status.description: The phase the room should show now.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_room
title: Switch the room phase of a webinar
